correctness.rationale: Under the literal printed transitions, \(a^2\) maps \(Q_n\) to \(\{3,\ldots,n\}\); \(b^{n-2}\) then maps this to \(\{1,\ldots,n-2\}\). Each further block \(a^2b^{n-2}\) removes the two largest states from an initial interval, so after \(\lfloor(n-2)/2\rfloor\) blocks the image is \(\{1,2\}\) or \(\{1,2,3\}\), and the final \(a^2\) maps it to \(\{3\}\). The length inequalities are exact parity calculations. Independent power-automaton BFS for \(4\le n\le12\) confirms the witness and finds no longer threshold than it; finite computation is not used for the universal proof.
